name: S1_T1
_about: Pre-registered Stage 14 tuning plan (approved 2026-09-28). Frozen before any tuning run; its SHA-256 is recorded in the tuning manifest and in the lock. Study §10: tune only on S1 with seeds 101-105, then freeze. Only tau_s and w_max_s are varied; every other SmartParams value stays at the study default (max green 45/30 s, min greens, extended initial, green bonus, fault recall).
objective: min mean control delay (delay_mean_s) over the tuning seeds
hard_constraints: signal log: legal transitions, exact RY/FG/Y/AR durations, GREEN+FLASHING_GREEN >= standard minimum green
deterministic result (selected candidate and Smart-study re-run and compared)
one arrival checksum per seed across all candidates and references

guardrail_definitions.p95: mean over the 5 seeds of the run's P95 control delay must not exceed Smart-study's
guardrail_definitions.max: the largest per-run maximum control delay over the 5 seeds may exceed Smart-study's by at most 10 %

tie_rule: candidates whose mean delay is within 1 % of the best feasible candidate are equal; prefer fewer changed parameters, then the smallest sum of relative distances |x - default| / default, then the fixed grid order (tau ascending, W_MAX ascending)
